english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the alcoholic drink and for referring to a variety of beer.
Use this when “suds” is casual slang for beer, especially in a food-and-drink context.

examples.english: This beer is a little bitter.
examples.jyutping: nei1 zek3 be1 zau2 jau5 siu2 siu2 fu2

examples.english: We ordered some suds to go with our burgers.
examples.traditional: 我哋食漢堡嗰陣叫咗幾杯啤酒。
